01 — Talk to the model

Part I · Wire · Difficulty: easy-medium · 30–50 minutes · 9 graded cases

You will build the one function everything else in this course calls: a client for an OpenAI-compatible endpoint that turns a Server-Sent-Events stream back into a single Message.
How it worksoverview.md — the seam, the delta log, the failure map
What to buildproblem.md — the contract, the graded claims, the hints
Full implementationexample.md — annotated, after an attempt
You editagent/provider_openai.go only
Given to youagent/types.go, internal/fake/ (a scripted server)

Read overview.md first. Then work from problem.md. Open example.md only after kata submit 01 passes or after you have been genuinely stuck.

Done when

kata submit 01 reports 9/9, and you can answer the self-check at the bottom of overview.md without scrolling up.
